children: American Superconductor Corp. (AMSC) filed a Form 8K - Director, Officer or Compensation Filing - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on September 21, 2026.

(b) On September 17, 2026, Barbara G. Littlefield informed the Board of Directors (the "Board") of American Superconductor Corporation of her resignation from the Board, effective at 12 p.m. eastern time on Friday, September 18, 2026.
The full text of this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/880807/000143774926030822/amsc20260921_8k.htm
Any exhibits and associated documents for this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/880807/000143774926030822/0001437749-26-030822-index.htm
Public companies must file a Form 8-K, or current report, with the SEC generally within four days of any event that could materially affect a company's financial position or the value of its shares.
